Name: Attic For Farmhouse
Author: redking1357
Description:
[b][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]About :[/size][/color][/b]
﻿Compatible with SDV 1.6 .[size=2]Adding a Decorable Attic to Farmhouse. Attic will get bigger at 1st and 2nd upgrade of farmhouse. The Attic can be decorate with Furniture , Wallpaper and Floor.

[/size][size=3][b]Configuration:﻿[/b][/size]
[size=2]- Attic_Room :
             "AllowValues" : "Default, Clean, Small , Small-and-Clean",
    ﻿﻿"Default": "[size=2]Default[/size]"
-  AtticAfterFirstUpgrade:
             "Default": "false"
      Attic Will Available After FarmHouse First Upgrade.
[/size]-   ExtraRoom:
             "Default": "false"
      Add ExtraRoom for Attic.


Attic Ladder Position:
﻿"Ladder_X": {
            "Default": 1,
            "Section": "Attic",
             
        },
"Ladder_Y": {
            "Default": 1,
            "Section": "Attic",    
        } 
"ExLadder_X": {
            "Default": 4,
            "Section": "ExtraRoom",
             
        },
"ExLadder_Y": {
            "Default": 1,
            "Section": "ExtraRoom",    
        },

 (If Ladder To Attic is not in the farmhouse after upgrade, change the location in the configuration)
[size=3][b]Installation :[/b][/size]
[size=2]1. Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download & install all Requirements ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296][size=2]Esca Modding Plugin[/size][/url] &[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9651][size=2]Farmhouse Fixes[/size][/url]﻿)
3. Download and Unzip all the files to your mods folder ( Stardew Valley / mods ).

[/size][b][size=3]Required :[/size][/b]
[size=2]-[b]  [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
